source_binding.scope: Implementation and all compiler/tool/test inputs frozen at the stated revision; acceptance documentation finalized afterward

validation.full_run_kind: serial with authenticated AIR cache hits

diagnostic.scope: complete original-input selection; no complete compiler/runtime object or execution credit

core.scope: Executable metadata is compared separately; selected-object bytes and all observation fields must match

zig_corpus.selection_comparison_scope: Recorded separately; a capability repair may change selection while preserving all oracle observations

retention.scope: Runners clean their own disposable temporary state; retained evidence, original inputs and scratch are preserved

excluded_development_attempts: The first native development fixture included an existing unsupported literal-accumulator form; its retained failure is excluded from acceptance, and the final fixture tests a spilled left operand with a high-bit right literal
The baseline native compilation and wrong-constant executable are expected rejection controls
limitations: Selection counts do not establish complete compiler/runtime object emission, startup or self-rebuild
Three targeted functions advance to existing freeze-width or PHI limitations
Selected core objects and observations match; wrapper metadata is reviewed separately without a whole-executable identity claim
Timings and global filesystem samples include concurrent activity and are not throughput or exclusive disk-usage measurements
